points.description: States that bulb A is still in a closed (complete) circuit/path with the battery and switch Z, so current can flow through it.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that bulb A remains in a closed circuit with the battery and switch Z (equivalent wording such as 'complete path' or 'circuit is still complete through Z' is accepted). No marks for answers that only say the bulb is 'on' or refer to switch Y without identifying the closed path through Z.
